images.prompt: Photorealistic split-screen vertical fashion editorial image, divided exactly in half by a clean straight vertical seam at the center. The top 24 percent of the whole image is empty plain background on both halves. LEFT HALF: a flat lay product photograph viewed from directly above on a light ivory plaster background, no person, items only in the lower 76 percent, neatly arranged top to bottom with small gaps: a folded navy blue chunky knit shawl scarf, a bulky oversized oatmeal cream chunky cable knit cardigan, a plain white cropped short-sleeve t-shirt, a small ivory leather mini shoulder bag next to a large slouchy chocolate brown suede shoulder bag, heather grey cotton jogger pants with elastic cuffs, a pair of white low-top leather sneakers. RIGHT HALF: a headless body-only full-body street style photo of a young Korean woman in her 20s wearing exactly the same items: the navy knit shawl draped over her shoulders, the open bulky oatmeal cardigan over the white cropped t-shirt, grey joggers, white sneakers, carrying BOTH the small ivory mini bag and the big brown suede bag on the same shoulder, walking past a quiet airport departure hall with soft blurred windows, only in the lower 76 percent, the frame is cut at the collarbone so there is NO head, NO chin, NO mouth, NO hair visible at all. Identical items in both halves, realistic fabric textures, soft overcast morning daylight, 35mm film look. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no signs.
